availability_eras.interpretation: A long replay is a current-formula reconstruction with changing subleg availability. It is never labelled the exact current issued model. Pre-2012 evidence is descriptive-only.

primary.name: Shanghai Composite
primary.reason: Exact committed deep-history cash/index series and commissioned primary benchmark.

secondary_proxy.name: CSI 300 ETF
secondary_proxy.status: proxy diagnostic only; MUST NOT be called exact CSI300 cash index

breadth.rules: Current curated 82-name large-cap roster, not historical membership. Report n_members on every row/slice; never call this genuine PIT breadth.

liquidity.rules: M2 reference-month history must be availability-shifted. SHIBOR daily observations may enter at the end-of-day stamp.

risk.rules: RORO rolling/trailing transforms only. Market-price/flow inputs use same-day end-of-day data. M1/M2 becomes knowable only under the frozen release-lag rules below. Current-universe breadth survivorship limitation applies.

stress.rules: Slowdown macro inputs availability-shifted; drawdown gauge uses only contemporaneously available reconstructed components. Slowdown is intentionally tracked as correlated/double-carried exposure because it also enters liquidity and stress.

trend.rules: Use only closes on/before stamp; completed W/M bars. Exact-production primary keeps the current default-US 3-session anchor; CN-session-anchor construction is a mandatory sensitivity.

vol.rules: QVIX and margin are end-of-day/snapshot histories; no values after stamp. QVIX depth is materially shorter than margin.

current_model.score: raw six-leg blend before evidence-gated Radar/override caps

today_orientation.usage: Orientation/current-semantics check only. Never an evaluation target or tuning datum.

current_model.top_level_missingness: Production renormalizes weights over available top-level legs. Primary P3 comparisons require all six top-level legs.

decision_gates.COMPONENT: KEEP if full model robustly improves over its LOCO counterpart; REMOVE_CANDIDATE if LOCO robustly improves full model; DISPLAY_ONLY if incremental forward value is absent with adequate evidence but descriptive coherence remains; NEED_MORE_DATA if coverage/composition/effective-N prevents adjudication.

CURRENT_WEIGHTS.EQUAL_WEIGHT_BETTER: Equal weight improves primary SHCOMP discrimination with paired uncertainty supporting the improvement, is non-worse on the other preregistered tail target, stays directionally stable in both halves and post-2016, and the ETF-proxy diagnostic does not materially contradict it.
CURRENT_WEIGHTS.INSUFFICIENT: Timing/calendar/era sensitivity materially changes the conclusion, intervals remain non-decisive, effective sample is too weak for the claim, or evidence class cannot support it.
CURRENT_WEIGHTS.RETAIN: Incumbent is not anti-predictive and no frozen challenger robustly dominates it under paired uncertainty and the required stability slices.
CURRENT_WEIGHTS.REWEIGHT_CANDIDATE: A frozen non-equal challenger or LOCO variant robustly dominates current under the same gates. Candidate only; retrospective evidence does not authorize production reweighting.

decision_gates.CUT_42: DEFENSIBLE if adjacent-band/event separation is stable and no neighboring frozen lower cut robustly dominates; PRODUCT_ONLY if the partition is coherent/descriptive but forward separation is weak; CHANGE_CANDIDATE if a neighboring frozen cut robustly dominates across required slices; otherwise INSUFFICIENT.
decision_gates.CUT_60: Same enum/gate logic, evaluated on benign-event and forward-return separation rather than treating 60 as a probability threshold.
decision_gates.SCORE_0_100: FORECAST_CAPABLE requires a separate same-model genuinely issued prospective cohort plus accepted promotion law. This retrospective P3 can at most earn CONDITIONAL_FORECAST_VALUE; otherwise DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.

evidence_authority.A: Reconstructed historical evidence, including release-lagged current-vintage macro and current-universe breadth.
evidence_authority.B: Genuinely issued same-model prospective evidence. P3 does not manufacture or backfill this class.
evidence_authority.C: Accepted authority/promotion evidence. Cannot be earned by prose or by class-A results.
evidence_authority.rule: Never convert A -> C. If future prospective evidence is warranted, extend the existing forward-log/issue-receipt discipline; do not create a second validation ledger.

fixed_models.loco: Remove exactly one top-level component at a time and renormalize the remainder.
fixed_models.optimization: FORBIDDEN. No learned/free weight search, cut search, or post-outcome challenger addition.

frozen_release_lag_rules.classification: RELEASE_LAGGED_CURRENT_VINTAGE is evidence class A only. It does NOT reconstruct historical revisions and is not genuine vintage PIT.
frozen_release_lag_rules.cpi_ppi: reference month -> calendar day 16 of following month
frozen_release_lag_rules.daily_market_flow_vol: same end-of-day stamp; outcomes begin strictly next session
frozen_release_lag_rules.gdp: quarter reference month -> calendar day 20 of following month
frozen_release_lag_rules.home_price: reference month -> calendar day 20 of following month
frozen_release_lag_rules.m1_m2_new_loans: reference month -> calendar day 16 of following month
frozen_release_lag_rules.pmi: reference month -> last calendar day of the same month
frozen_release_lag_rules.principle: These rules create no new temporal ledger. They are research-only transformations of current-vintage stores. Availability date is mapped to the first Shanghai Composite session STRICTLY AFTER the stated calendar availability date, deliberately conservative about intraday release time.
frozen_release_lag_rules.tsf: use stored availability_date when present; otherwise day 16 of following month

metrics.brier: FORBIDDEN on raw 0-100 score. Raw score is not a probability.
cut_60: benign-event separation and forward-return separation between Mixed and Risk-on; no implied probability claim
metrics.episode_view: Cluster contiguous Risk-off / event-condition runs as episodes for human-readable effective-N; daily rows are not independent authority.
event_discrimination: ROC-AUC using inverse score for dd21_5pct and dd42_10pct
event rate and lift vs unconditional base rate by score band/cut
precision and recall of the lower-cut Risk-off partition
return_magnitude: mean and median ret21/ret42 by band
metrics.uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap with block length equal to the evaluated forward horizon (21 or 42 sessions), deterministic seed=7. Report 95% intervals and engine.grading_stats.effective_n for overlapping daily windows.

mission: Determine whether the current China Market State six-component construction, hand weights, and 42/60 product cuts add information beyond simple A-share baselines; determine what the 0-100 score may honestly mean. Research only; no production behavior, sizing, mapping, UI, Risk Radar, or live China-score changes.

structural_sensitivities.breadth_membership: Report current-roster n_members and stratify/check stability as roster depth changes. Current 82-name universe is survivorship-affected.
structural_sensitivities.missingness: Report renormalization and component availability. No silent neutral imputation.
structural_sensitivities.subleg_composition: Report active RORO/vol/slowdown/drawdown subleg counts. Historical rows with different composition cannot be described as same-issued-model evidence.
structural_sensitivities.trend_calendar: Primary reproduces current production default-US 3-session anchor exactly; mandatory counterfactual passes market=CN. Never silently repair production in P3.

targets.anchor: Score is stamped after session close. Forward window starts at the first Shanghai Composite close strictly after the stamp.

threshold_grid.use: Sensitivity only. No post-hoc production cut is selected from this grid.
